section_header: A340E (2JZ-GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION
title: COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION
ocr_text:
AT-108
A340E (2JZ-GTE)  AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION  -  COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION

Union
Y_003892

44.  INSTALL UNIONS
(a)  Coat 2 new O-rings with ATF and install them to each union.
(b)  Install each union.
Torque: 29 N·m (300 kgf·cm, 22 ft·lbf)

Y_003891

45.  INSTALL OIL TEMPERATURE SENSOR
(a)  Coat a new O-ring with ATF and install it to the oil temp. sensor.
(b)  Install the oil temp. sensor.
Torque: 29 N·m (300 kgf·cm, 22 ft·lbf)

Neutral Position
AT5228

46.  INSTALL PARK/NEUTRAL POSITION SWITCH
(a)  Using the control shaft lever, fully turn the manual lever shaft back and return 2 notches. It is now in neutral.

Y_003890

(b)  Insert the park/neutral position switch onto the manual valve lever shaft and temporarily tighten the adjusting bolt.
(c)  Install the grommet and a new lock washer. Install and torque the nut.
Torque: 7 N·m (70 kgf·cm, 61 in.·lbf)

Neutral Basic Line
Bolt
Groove
AT5115

(d)  Clean the threads of the adjusting bolt and case with white gasoline.
(e)  Apply seal packing or equivalent to the adjusting bolt.
Seal packing:
Part No.08833-00070, THREE BOND 1324 or equivalent
(f)  Align the neutral basic line and the switch groove, and tighten the adjusting bolt.
Torque: 13 N·m (130 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)
